identity.name: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
identity.summary: An instruction-tuned multilingual text model optimized for dialogue use cases.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: instruction-tuned dialogue model trained on public online data with no reported factuality/grounding evaluation -> hallucination risk

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: gated access but no stated privacy safeguards for user-supplied text in dialogue use -> confidential data may be sent in prompts

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: dialogue model accepts arbitrary text prompts and card reports no IP filtering -> copyrighted material may be included in prompts

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: card states training on a new mix of publicly available online data but reports no training footprint -> plausible environmental impact

specifications.model_size: 15.0 GiB of safetensors weights (16,060,556,376 bytes) in BF16

training_context.training_data: The model was trained on a new mix of publicly available online data.
